verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Azure Copilot can generate Terraform/IaC configurations from natural-language prompts (azure-docs-19) and that Microsoft ships an official MCP server (azure-probe-4) that could let AI agents issue natural-language-driven operations against Azure, but the bulk of the operational surface (CLI, ARM/Bicep, REST APIs) is scripted/declarative rather than natural-language driven. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of a conversational/natural-language interface across core Azure resource management (not just Terraform generation), hands-on or independent verification that NL commands reliably operate Azure services, and clarity on scope/maturity of the MCP server for full agentic control.
